_readme: Historical audit findings that have been investigated and explained. They are
reported by papertrade/verify.py as 'acknowledged' rather than failing the build,
so that CI goes red on a NEW divergence instead of staying permanently red on
known history that cannot be undone.
This is a record, not a mute button. Add an entry only after establishing what
actually happened and writing the reason down. An unexplained finding must fail.
Match is exact on day + check + substring.

Real defect, found by this auditor on 2026-09-08, three weeks after the fact. The yfinance feed had not published Monday 2026-08-17's bar when the run fetched at 13:20:31Z, so signal_date stayed at Friday 2026-08-14 (sessions count stuck at 307, jumping to 309 on 08-19). Every price rule that session ran a bar behind. Measured consequence: TWLO's 5% stop triggered on the 08-17 close but was not acted on until 08-19, one session late. Cannot be undone retroactively; the auditor now fails the build if it recurs.
